Third-party notices for the Plotly.js 2.27.0 full distribution
==========================================================

This companion notice file was assembled for Ca2tchAll from the copyright
and license comments in the upstream unminified distribution:
https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/v2.27.0/dist/plotly.js

It is not an upstream-generated artifact. Preserve LICENSE-plotly.txt, this
file, and the library's original header when redistributing the library.
The original minified header refers to plotly.min.js.LICENSE.txt, so this
file keeps that name even though the application renames the JavaScript.

Retained upstream notices
